description: Public Wi-Fi in Pedestrian Corridors and Public Computer Centers is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. The Public Wi-Fi in Pedestrian Corridors and Public Computer Centers dataset is an analysis of Public Wi-Fi hotspots in pedestrian corridors (zones of commercial activity in each neighborhood that attract the greatest numbers of people and local businesses) and Public Wi-Fi hotspots in the City's public computer centers. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are hotspot, computer center, commercial districts, broadband, wi-fi. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI). The portal shows 2019-07-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
